sloka: राम दाशरथे वीर वीर्यम् ते श्रूयते अद्भुतम् ।धनुषो भेदनम् चैव निखिलेन मया श्रुतम् ॥१-७५-१॥
transliteration: rāma dāśarathe vīra vīryam te śrūyate adbhutam ।dhanuṣo bhedanam caiva nikhilena mayā śrutam ॥1-75-1॥

translations.english: "O Rama, Rama, son of Dasaratha I have heard in full of your marvellous prowess and your feat in breaking the bow of Siva.
